name: 标准分 Z 值计算器

map.数据偏离均值的标准差倍数。: How many standard deviations a value lies from the mean.
map.标准分把原始值 x 减去均值 μ 再除以标准差 σ，得到相对均值的标准差数。z: A z-score subtracts the mean μ from the raw value x and divides by the standard deviation σ, giving the distance from the mean in standard deviations. z > 0 lies above the mean and z < 0 below it; z-scores are used for standardization and outlier detection, where |z| > 2 or 3 is treated as unusual.
map.离群识别、跨分布比较。: Outlier detection and comparison across distributions.
map.x=190cm、μ=170、σ=10：z=2.0，高于均值 2σ（约超 97.7: x=190cm, μ=170, σ=10: z=2.0, i.e. 2σ above the mean (ahead of about 97.7% of observations).
map.x=140：z=−3.0，低于均值 3σ，可能异常或特殊亚群。: x=140: z=−3.0, three standard deviations below the mean, which may indicate an anomaly or a distinct subgroup.
map.能，表示低于均值；|z| 表距离。: Yes, they indicate values below the mean, while |z| gives the distance.
map.σ 用样本还是总体？: Should σ be the sample or population value?
map.已知总体参数用总体 σ；抽样时用样本 s（此时严格应为 t 分数）。: Use the population σ when the parameters are known; under sampling use the sample s, which strictly speaking gives a t score.
